summary: The scene is an exterior establishing shot of a building. It is described as 'Tenement-like and vast,' and the narration states that 'it is the kind of place where people can disappear.' No characters appear and no dialogue is spoken; the description functions as a mood-setting image of a structure where occupants can vanish unnoticed.
